peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Lower relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Lower relative price than most peers: 13.4% below its local comparables; 32 of 130 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (97.6): 7.1 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 383 of 393 similar developments with a figure (the same as 1). Context, not scored: resales in 29.2% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 1-bedroom: median $750,000 ($1,548 psf, 484 sq ft; 5 resales, Sep 2024–Aug 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,788 psf (range $1,629–1,877); 13.4% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $116,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Boon Keng MRT about 740 m, Potong Pasir MRT about 750 m; closer than 107 of 662 similar developments (the same as 7). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 3 within 1 km and 6 within 2 km; nearest Bendemeer Primary School about 540 m; more than 547 of 662 similar developments (the same as 73). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 6 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 700 m), more than 207 of 662 similar developments (the same as 35); nearest hawker centre Bendemeer Market And Food Centre about 800 m; nearest park Greenway South about 1,110 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 1 other condo development sold new homes within 2 km (The Arcady at Boon Keng, 32 new sales, about 350 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 186 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 32 new sales and 650 resales (682 purchases); new sales were 4.7% of these purchases. Subsales (56) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Kallang Close GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,610 m; Dorset Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,760 m; The Serra Residences (launch, launched, about 4 homes), about 1,820 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 650 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 224 of 662 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 650 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 741 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−12.3%). Planning-area private resales −11.3%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
